summary: Make automatically generated patient identifiers retry-safe
description:
Impact
Retrying a partially completed save can consume multiple generated identifier values. When editing an existing patient, it can also attach duplicate identifiers.
For a new patient, retries waste generated values but do not attach duplicates. Once the patient exists, the retry goes through PatientResource1_8.update, which only applies the person block and ignores the identifiers array.
Affected code
packages/esm-patient-registration-app/src/patient-registration/form-manager.ts

packages/esm-patient-registration-app/src/patient-registration/form-manager.test.ts

Root cause
Each save attempt generates identifiers again. The save transaction remembers whether the main patient request succeeded, but it does not remember generated values or successful identifier additions.
Newly added identifier fields have no identifierUuid (initializeIdentifier never sets one), so every retry POSTs to /patient/{uuid}/identifier without a uuid and the REST resource creates a new row each time.
Each call to /idgen/identifiersource/{uuid}/identifier writes a log entry and advances the sequence, so every retry consumes a value.
If a later operation fails, retrying repeats identifier work that already completed.
Reproduction
Edit an existing patient.

Add an identifier configured for automatic generation.

Submit the form.

Allow the identifier request to succeed, then make a later operation fail.

Retry the submission.

Another identifier is generated and attached to the patient.
Expected behavior
Retrying the same submission should reuse the generated value and should not repeat an identifier addition that already succeeded.
Implementation direction
Extend the save transaction state to retain generated identifier values and completed identifier additions, keyed by a stable identifier field key.
Use serializable records rather than Set or Map. The transaction manager is stored inside _patientRegistrationData for offline synchronization.
Retry only operations that did not complete successfully.
Note on offline: esm-core's sync (processHandler in esm-offline/src/sync.ts) only writes lastError back to IndexedDB on failure. It never persists the mutated item content, so no transaction state (including today's patientSaved) survives between sync runs. Fixing that belongs in esm-core and is out of scope here. Offline mode is also disabled in the reference application (supportOffline: false), so the online retry path is what matters.
Acceptance criteria
A generated identifier is generated once across retries of the same submission.

A successful identifier addition is not repeated.

A failed identifier addition is retried.

New-patient retries do not consume another generated value.

Existing-patient retries do not attach duplicate identifiers.

The transaction state is made up of plain serializable objects (no Set or Map).

Add tests that fail a later operation and then retry with the same transaction state.

Verified against openmrs-esm-patient-management commit c64fb336. Still applies at e23ce30c; the only change to form-manager.ts since is O3-5913 (awaiting identifier deletions), which does not touch identifier generation.
